agenda_text:
TRANSPORTATION AND PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  TEMPLE CITY, CALIFORNIA

  REGULAR MEETING
  DECEMBER 10, 2025 - 7:00 P.M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS– 5938 KAUFFMAN AVE

  AGENDA

PROCEDURE TO ADDRESS TRANSPORTATION AND PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION: If
you wish to address the Transportation and Public Safety Commission, please complete a
speaker request form, indicating the agenda item number and submit it to the Clerk. There will
be a 3-minute time limit on each speaker, unless waived by the Commission. You have the
opportunity to address the Commission at the following times:

  •  AGENDA ITEM: at the time the Commission considers the agenda item.

  •  NON-AGENDA ITEM: at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while
  the Commission values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the Commission
  cannot take action on any item not listed on the agenda.

The listing of any items on the agenda includes the authority of the Commission to take action
on such item and to approve, disapprove, or give direction on any item.

  1.  CALL TO ORDER – Chairman Nimri

  2.  ROLL CALL – Commissioner Catalan, Lo, Xu, Stoll, Nimri

  3.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  4.  CEREMONIAL MATTERS – None

  5.  PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA

  The Transportation and Public Safety Commission will now hear public
  comments regarding items not listed on the agenda. The procedure to address
  the Commission is highlighted on the first page of this agenda.

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  All Consent Calendar items may be approved in a single motion as
  recommended unless removed for further discussion. If members of the
  Commission or persons in the audience wish to discuss any matters listed on
  the Consent Calendar, please address them at this time.

  Recommendation:  Approve Item A per recommendation.

  A.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES – REGULAR MEETING OF OCTOBER 8,
  2025

  Recommendation:  Approve.

7.  PARKING CITATION HEARINGS – None

8.  UNFINISHED BUSINESS - None

9.  NEW BUSINESS

  A. TRAFFIC REVIEW OF W LIVE OAK AVENUE BETWEEN ROWLAND
  AVENUE AND BALDWIN AVENUE, TO INSTALL EITHER ADDITIONAL
  RED CURB OR NO STOPPING ANYTIME SIGNAGE.

  Presenter:  Jana Robbins, Transtech Engineers, Inc.

  The Transportation and Public Safety Commission is requested to review the
  engineering recommendation to install either additional red curb, (Option 1),
  or No stopping Anytime signage, (Option 2), of the engineering report, in
  order to maintain a clear pathway for eastbound thru vehicles approaching
  the intersection, of W Live Oak Avenue between Rowland Avenue, and
  Baldwin Avenue.

10.  COMMUNICATIONS – None

11.  ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA - None

12.  MATTERS FROM CITY OFFICIALS

13.  COMMISSION ITEMS SEPARATE FROM THE REGULAR AGENDA

  A.  COMMISSIONER CATALAN

  B.  COMMISSIONER STOLL

  C.  COMMISSOINER XU

  D.  VICE CHAIRMAN NIMRI

  E.  CHAIRMAN LO

14.  ADJOURNMENT

  The next regular meeting of the Transportation and Public Safety Commission
  will be held on December 24, 2025, at 7:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers, 5938
  Kauffman Avenue, Temple City.

  NEXT REGULAR MEETING OF:

  CITY COUNCIL  7:30 P.M.  Dec. 16, 2025

Notice: Staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business of
this Agenda are available for viewing on the City’s website at www.templecity.us and
are on file in the Community Development Department located at City Hall, 9701 Las
Tunas Drive, Temple City, California, and are available for review during regular office
hours.

 In compliance with the American with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to
 participate in this meeting, please contact the Secretary at (626) 285-2171. Notification 48
 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure
 accessibility to this meeting.

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that
the foregoing agenda was posted on the Civic Center bulletin board not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

Yansy Monroy, Secretary
